Container.Name: Sylo
Container.Overview:
Sylo is a multi-function Discord bot with a web dashboard. It has a per-guild module system (30 modules) - moderation with warning thresholds and a numbered case log (/history, /case), server logging, tickets/modmail answered from the dashboard, reaction roles & autoroles, verification (Verify button or Cloudflare Turnstile captcha), welcome/leave messages, a Welcome Channel builder, birthday announcements, sticky messages, auto-moderation (invite/link/flood/mention/caps/word filters, optionally pushed to Discord's native AutoMod), a counting mini-game, action-based custom slash commands, an autoresponder, reminders (one-off or recurring channel posts), leveling (text + optional voice XP, per-role/channel multipliers, all-time/weekly/monthly public leaderboard), AFK, server statistics (live-count voice channels), server insights (activity charts - messages, joins/leaves and voice-channel usage over time), a free games notifier (Epic Games Store, plus more stores with an IsThereAnyDeal key), ban appeals (banned members get a DM'd link to an appeal form; staff accept/deny from the dashboard), MEE6-style temporary voice channels ("join to create" hubs plus /voice-* control commands), a starboard (re-posts messages that get enough of a reaction into a highlights channel), an invite tracker (credits who invited each member and ranks inviters), reaction polls (/poll with a timer or vote cap), prize giveaways (Enter button, auto-drawn winners), optional Battlefield-series and RuneScape (OSRS/RS3) player stats (/stats, gated by the Game stats module), Twitch / YouTube / Kick go-live & new-video alerts (with an optional "delete the message when the stream ends" mode), RSS/Atom feed alerts (plus Reddit / Mastodon / Bluesky handles), and a message/embed creator - plus per-server command management, a Prometheus /metrics endpoint (a ready-made Grafana dashboard ships in the repo), and an editable Discord presence/activity. State is stored in a single SQLite file under /app/data and survives updates. The database is snapshotted automatically (before every schema migration and on a schedule) into /app/data/backups - optionally shipped off-site as well (WebDAV and/or a Discord webhook; see BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL / BACKUP_WEBHOOK_URL); from the dashboard's Health page you can also create, download, import and restore a snapshot (restore swaps the file and lets the container restart on the restored data).
Setup: create a Discord application at https://discord.com/developers/applications, then set DISCORD_TOKEN (Bot tab) and DISCORD_CLIENT_ID (General Information). Invite the bot with the scopes "bot" and "applications.commands".
Intents: the member/message-driven modules (logging, welcome, reaction roles, verification, leveling, server statistics, invite tracker, auto-moderation, counting, autoresponder, starboard) need the "Server Members" and/or "Message Content" intents enabled on the Developer Portal Bot page. Leave INTENT_GUILD_MEMBERS / INTENT_MESSAGE_CONTENT at their defaults, or set one to false to boot without that intent (its modules stay unavailable).
Dashboard: runs open by default (use only on a trusted LAN). To require "Log in with Discord" for server admins, set DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET and add http://[UNRAID-IP]:[HOST-PORT]/auth/discord/callback to the app's OAuth2 Redirects.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Sylo dashboard. Only change the host side; the container always listens on 3000.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database (sylo.db) is stored. Persists across updates/restarts.

Config.Name: DISCORD_TOKEN
Config.Description: Discord bot token (Developer Portal -> your app -> Bot -> Reset Token).

Config.Name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Discord application (client) ID (Developer Portal -> your app -> General Information).

Config.Name: DISCORD_DEV_GUILD_IDS
Config.Description: Optional. Set to a server ID (or several, comma-separated) to register slash commands to those guild(s) instantly (useful for testing). Leave blank to register globally (can take up to ~1 hour the first time).

Config.Name: DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Set this (Developer Portal -> OAuth2 -> Client Secret) to require 'Log in with Discord' on the dashboard, restricted to server admins. Also add http://[UNRAID-IP]:[HOST-PORT]/auth/discord/callback to the app's OAuth2 Redirects. Leave blank to run the dashboard open (trusted LAN only).

Config.Name: INTENT_GUILD_MEMBERS
Config.Description: Whether to request the Server Members privileged intent (needed by logging, welcome, reaction roles/autoroles, verification, leveling, server statistics and the invite tracker). Must also be enabled on the Developer Portal Bot page. Set to false to boot without it - those modules then stay unavailable.

Config.Name: INTENT_MESSAGE_CONTENT
Config.Description: Whether to request the Message Content privileged intent (needed by logging, auto-moderation, the autoresponder, the counting game and the starboard). Must also be enabled on the Developer Portal Bot page. Set to false to boot without it - those modules then stay unavailable.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Any long random string; signs the dashboard session cookie so logins survive a container restart. Auto-generated when blank.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_URL
Config.Description: Optional. The public dashboard URL (e.g. https://sylo.example.com or http://[UNRAID-IP]:[HOST-PORT]). Needed behind a reverse proxy for the OAuth2 redirect URI, and to build the links members open for verification-captcha and ban appeals. Leave blank for direct IP access without those features.

Config.Name: TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile site key — enables the Verification module's captcha mode. Free at dash.cloudflare.com -> Turnstile. Needs both keys and DASHBOARD_URL set; otherwise captcha mode falls back to a plain Verify button.

Config.Name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile secret key — pairs with TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY for the Verification captcha.

Config.Name: ITAD_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. IsThereAnyDeal API key (free at isthereanydeal.com/apps) — broadens the Free games module beyond the Epic Games Store to Steam, GOG, Fanatical, Humble and more. Without it, Free games is Epic-only.

Config.Name: TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Twitch application client id for the Twitch alerts module ('go live' notifications). Free app at dev.twitch.tv/console. Needs TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET too; without both, the module's poll loop does nothing.

Config.Name: TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Twitch application client secret, paired with TWITCH_CLIENT_ID for the Twitch alerts module.

Config.Name: KICK_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Kick application client id for the Kick alerts module ('go live' notifications). Free app at kick.com/settings/developer. Needs KICK_CLIENT_SECRET too; without both, the module's poll loop does nothing.

Config.Name: KICK_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Kick application client secret, paired with KICK_CLIENT_ID for the Kick alerts module.

Config.Name: STATS_CACHE_TTL_MINUTES
Config.Description: How long (minutes) to cache a stats lookup before hitting the API again.

Config.Name: GAMETOOLS_API_BASE
Config.Description: Base URL of the Battlefield stats API.

Config.Name: DATABASE_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite file inside the container. Must sit inside the Data Directory mount.

Config.Name: BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS
Config.Description: How often (hours) to write an automatic compacted database snapshot into <Data Directory>/backups. A snapshot is also always taken just before a schema migration, and on demand from the Health page. Set to 0 to disable the scheduled backup.

Config.Name: BACKUP_RETENTION
Config.Description: How many database snapshots to keep in <Data Directory>/backups. Older ones are pruned automatically.

Config.Name: BACKUP_DIR
Config.Description: Optional. Directory (inside the container) for database snapshots. Leave blank to use <Data Directory>/backups; must sit inside the Data Directory mount if set.

Config.Name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Off-site backups: a WebDAV folder URL (e.g. a Nextcloud path like https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me/sylo-backups). After every local snapshot a gzipped copy is PUT to <url>/<name>.db.gz. Best-effort and logged; never blocks the local backup.

Config.Name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_USER
Config.Description: Optional. Username for BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL (HTTP basic auth). Use an app password, not your account password.

Config.Name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_PASS
Config.Description: Optional. Password / app password for BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL.

Config.Name: BACKUP_WEBHOOK_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Off-site backups: a Discord webhook URL. Each gzipped snapshot is uploaded as an attachment (skipped when it is over ~8 MiB — use WebDAV for a larger database).

Config.Name: WEB_PORT
Config.Description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Leave at 3000 unless you also change the container side of the WebUI Port mapping.

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Node environment.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. debug also emits one line per HTTP request.

Config.Name: LOG_FORMAT
Config.Description: Log line format: text or json (LOG_JSON=1 is shorthand for json).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: IANA timezone name, used for timestamps in ticket transcripts and logs. Defaults to Europe/Oslo.
